		limit = {
			has_building = wantilan_01

			aub_can_upgrade_to_wantilan_03_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = tribal_building_tier_3_cost }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_building = wantilan_03 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = tribal_building_tier_3_cost }
		}

	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = wantilan_03

# wawel_cathedral_01: 2 frozen upgrade edge(s)
aub_upgrade_chain_wawel_cathedral_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = wawel_cathedral_01
			aub_can_upgrade_to_wawel_cathedral_02_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = 800 }
		}
		remove_building = wawel_cathedral_01
		scope:aub_payer = { save_scope_as = character }
		add_special_building = wawel_cathedral_02
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = wawel_cathedral_02 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = 800 }
		}
		else = {
			scope:aub_payer = { save_scope_as = character }
			add_special_building = wawel_cathedral_01
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = wawel_cathedral_02
			aub_can_upgrade_to_wawel_cathedral_03_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = 1400 }
		}
		remove_building = wawel_cathedral_02
		scope:aub_payer = { save_scope_as = character }
		add_special_building = wawel_cathedral_03
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = wawel_cathedral_03 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = 1400 }
		}
		else = {
			scope:aub_payer = { save_scope_as = character }
			add_special_building = wawel_cathedral_02
		}
	}
}

			aub_can_upgrade_to_windmills_03_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_3_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = windmills_02
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = windmills_03 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_3_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = windmills_03
			aub_can_upgrade_to_windmills_04_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = windmills_03
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = windmills_04 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = windmills_04
			aub_can_upgrade_to_windmills_05_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_5_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = windmills_04
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = windmills_05 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_5_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = windmills_05
			aub_can_upgrade_to_windmills_06_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_6_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = windmills_05
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = windmills_06 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_6_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = windmills_06
			aub_can_upgrade_to_windmills_07_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_7_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = windmills_06
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = windmills_07 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_7_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = windmills_07
			aub_can_upgrade_to_windmills_08_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_8_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = windmills_07
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = windmills_08 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_8_cost }
		}
	}
}
